description.value:
Usage drawn on armor

This rune insulates from harmful energy of all kinds. The creature wearing the armor gains resistance [[4 + max(floor((@actor.level - 9) / 2), 0)]] to your choice of cold, electricity, or fire, and any creature that touches the rune-bearer or damages it with an unarmed attack or non-reach melee weapon takes [[2 + max(floor((@actor.level - 9) / 2), 0)]] damage of the chosen type. The rune has the trait of the energy type chosen.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-runesmith-assistant.pf2e-runesmith-assistant-items.Item.aa9Ncmtrwm1EThms]{Effect: Kojastri, Rune of Insulation}

Invocation Any creature that has the armor's wearer engulfed, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, or swallowed whole takes @Damage[(8 + floor((@actor.level - 9) / 2) * 2)d4[untyped]] damage of the rune's chosen type with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save against your class DC. On a failure, it also releases the armor's wearer.

Level (+2) The resistance and damage granted by insulation both increase by 1, and the damage dealt by the invocation increases by [[/r 2d4]].
